method: 4 rounds x arms [off, on, 16] interleaved back-to-back in one session so host drift cancels; reps=1 per command with kernels gemv, tiled; medians/min/max/spread parsed from raw logs after ANSI stripping.

on.verdict: no: arm `on` total_ms deltas vs baseline `off` do not exceed the noise band on every shape.

16.verdict: no: arm `16` total_ms deltas vs baseline `off` do not exceed the noise band on every shape.
